title: Streamlined verification orchestrator and cost-normalizer for Redwood-verified model metrics
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Publishing Redwood-verified model metrics (latency/throughput/cost) remains labor-intensive and brittle across regions and hardware variants. We often ship profiles that require ad-hoc manual adjustments for cost normalization and regional anchors, which slows onboarding and causes inconsistent routing decisions.

Goal: Build an orchestrator and lightweight playbook that automates verification, normalizes cost signals across HW types and regions, introduces a 'soft-pin' deployment option (traffic routing preference without hard lock), and standardizes the canary + rollback workflow for profile publish and refresh. The system should emit clear artifacts (signed manifests, delta reports) and integrate with the existing profile ledger and publish pipelines.

Outcomes: Reduce manual hours per profile by ~60%, shorten time-to-publish for validated models from days to hours, and reduce noisy runtime rollbacks by establishing deterministic acceptance criteria and automated rollback hooks.
acceptance_criteria: Verification orchestrator runs end-to-end for a candidate model and produces a signed manifest with latency/throughput/cost claims
Cost-normalizer module produces a normalized cost-per-token value across at least 3 HW classes (A100-40GB, H100-80GB, CPU-optimized) and attaches provenance metadata
Soft-pin routing flag supported by the control plane: routes prefer pinned variant but can fall back automatically under load or failure
Canary gate enforces sampled-shadow + 1% live traffic ramp with automated quality checks and rollback on regression
Artifacts (manifest, delta report, telemetry contract) be stored in git-backed registry and surface in Console publish UI
tasks: Design API contract for verification orchestrator and signed manifest schema
Implement cost-normalizer service (normalize by HW performance anchors + tokenization differences)
Extend publish pipeline to support 'soft-pin' flag and routed fallbacks
Wire canary flow: shadow sampling harness, incremental traffic ramp, automated regressions detection
Add manifest diff generator and human-friendly delta report for reviewers
Integrate with ledger: sign manifests and record provenance metadata
Update Console: publish modal shows normalized cost, soft-pin toggle, and canary status
Author runbook: how to interpret delta report, rollback steps, and emergency unpin procedure
Add E2E tests that simulate hardware variance and enforce normalization tolerances
